## About
TA Performance Products is a Scottsdale shop built around Buick engines. We carry high performance parts, stock replacement parts and restoration drivetrain components for big block, small block, Nailhead and turbo Buick engines.
Alongside the parts, we offer engine and machine services like cylinder head porting and flow testing, competition valve jobs, block and head surfacing, and distributor re-curving and tuning.
We're rated 4.6 from 61 Google reviews. For tech questions, give us a call. We don't handle tech support by email, so the phone is the best way to reach us.

## Services
- Cylinder head porting: Porting work on cylinder heads, along with intake manifold porting and port matching.
- Cylinder head flow testing: Flow testing to see how your heads are performing.
- Competition valve jobs: Valve jobs for competition builds.
- Block and head surfacing: Surfacing for cylinder blocks and heads.
- Distributor re-curving and tuning: Re-curving and tuning for your distributor. We also restore distributors.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours on Friday?
A: Friday is a short day. We're open from 8 AM to noon MST.

Q: Can I email you with tech questions?
A: We don't provide tech support by email. Please call us for all tech related questions. International customers can email with INTERNATIONAL in the subject line.

Q: Are the prices on the website current?
A: Prices on the website and in the catalog can change without notice, so please confirm the price with us when you place your order.
